name: creative-library-remote
description: Generate database-grounded ad and cold-email concepts through a private GammaFlow reference gateway.

interface.shortDescription: Private creative references, generated in your Codex.
interface.longDescription: Creates a 12-concept ad slate or three three-email sequences from one expiring, de-identified reference packet. Source records and database access remain private; generation runs in the signed-in Codex account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my authorized GammaFlow creative workflow for this campaign.
